title: Add Sales and Purchase Order execution timeline
description: Implement a read-oriented execution timeline for Sales Orders and Purchase Orders from existing document/status/stock/logistics data. Prefer derived events and existing persisted records; do not introduce production schema changes in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Sales Order detail can show a chronological execution timeline derived from existing order, shipment/stock and related document data.
Purchase Order detail can show a chronological execution timeline derived from existing order, receipt/stock and related document data.
Timeline events identify event type, document/reference number, timestamp/status and source without inventing unavailable data.
API queries are bounded and avoid N+1 behavior for normal order-detail use.
Unit/integration tests cover ordering, event mapping and empty/partial histories; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open a Sales Order and inspect its execution timeline.
Open a Purchase Order and inspect its execution timeline.

human_gate.reason: Read-oriented feature derived from existing persisted data; no production schema/deployment action.
